reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V4 (understeer-gradient kinematic) using fitted K_us per platform and 80 ms global lag from out/results.json; lowpass(δ,3Hz), psi_corr = (v/L)tan(δ_lpf)/(1+K_us·v²/L), added per-segment gyro bias and shifted by 4 samples to align with truth.
notes: V4 is the agent's declared best ('Headline result: ... 0.01568 rad/s (V4) — a 13.1% reduction'). Lag-shift creates 4 NaN samples per segment at index 0..3 (dropped by filter); agent's K_us was fit on the same Ford segment set (leakage accepted per YAML).
